name: The Forgetful Kiwi
source:
"The Forgetful Kiwi" consists of 2 short stories revolving around Kiwi, who is quite forgetful, as well as other friends he meets along the way.

1. Kiwi's Surprise - Kiwi is sent to the store to pick up a few items. Will he remember to go? Or will he goof off with Pingu instead.

2. Pingu's Birthday Party - Kiwi is invited to Pingu's birthday party, but gets lost along the way. There he meets an anteater that claims to know the way; however, he wants help first. Will Kiwi help him or not?

[Edited from [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=14699]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
《健忘的奇维》包含两篇短篇故事，围绕健忘的奇维，以及他在途中遇到的朋友们展开。

1．奇维的惊喜——奇维被派去商店买几样东西。他会记得去吗？还是会跑去和平古一起玩闹？

2．平古的生日派对——奇维受邀参加平古的生日派对，却在途中迷了路。他遇到了一只自称知道路的食蚁兽，不过对方想先请他帮个忙。奇维会帮他吗？
